facts.authoredFrom: Read from the case's input bytes: grund.toml writes `grund_config_version = 1` and `[reference] strict = false` (the version-1 reader, §FS-config.5; the compatibility mode of §FS-config.3.1), with default marker `§`, kinds and scan, so docs/ is read (§FS-config.3.5). Under `strict = false` an unmarked ID token is a citation as well as a marked one (§FS-citations.recognized): FS-001-alpha's line 3 `References FS-002-beta.` cites FS-002-beta and FS-002-beta's line 3 `References FS-001-alpha.` cites FS-001-alpha, both bare, the sentence-final `.` being punctuation. The index README cites each with a marked token inside its authored link. The FS home is docs/functional-spec/ and its index the default README.md (§FS-config.3.4.2); it holds both entries as full links whose destinations already name each declaration's own heading anchor (§FS-check.3.18, §FS-fmt.6.2.1, §FS-fmt.6.2.2: `# FS-001-alpha: Alpha` slugifies to fs-001-alpha-alpha, `# FS-002-beta: Beta` to fs-002-beta-beta), so no index finding arises and the index pass re-derives nothing (§FS-fmt.6.3); the index's citations sit under no declaration (its `# FS index` heading declares nothing). The bare ID-shaped text inside each link destination is no citation (§FS-citations.recognized.link-destinations), a heading's own ID is no citation (§FS-citations.recognized.title-lines), and `FS` alone is no ID. Each declaration's body runs from line 2 to the file's last line 4, a blank one, with no section heading (§FS-show.2.1.2, §FS-list.3.4.1). Both declarations are cited, every citation resolves, so the only finding is the site-less version caution (§FS-check.checks.config-version-1, §FS-config.5.3). FS-404 is the absent control. Fmt rewrites bare citations to marked ones only with --marker (§FS-fmt.2.2), and the cross-reference pass wraps only marked citations, leaving bare ones bare and unwrapped (§FS-fmt.6.5, §FS-fmt.6.2); the only marked citations are the already-canonical index links, so both the dry run and the write change nothing, under every variant and with the overlay's newline edit.

findings.message: grund.toml is version 1; migrate it with grund config migrate --to 2
